name: clients
description: Clients. Client engagements after the contract is signed. /project-setup starts an engagement from the executed contract (folder structure, phased plan, memory record) behind one confirmed plan, keeping finance-only terms out of shared places; /client-status drafts the weekly client-facing status update; /review-deliverable runs a brand and quality check before you ship; /sow turns a proposal into a Statement of Work in your own house format. SOW and status drafts are checked against their sources before you see them. Configure with /setup-projects and /setup-status.
